# plougonver.com

> > A comprehensive resource for home floor plans and architectural designs spanning Kerala traditional homes, modular residential construction, and healthcare facility planning.

Plougonver.com specializes in residential architecture and home design planning, with a strong focus on Kerala-style traditional homes and modular construction in North Carolina. The site also includes healthcare-related planning resources for hospital discharge procedures.

## Key Topics

- Kerala home plans
- Floor plans
- Residential architecture
- Modular homes
- Home design
- House plans
- Kerala-style architecture
- North Carolina
- Architectural elevation
- Traditional house design
- Nalukettu design
- Residential design
- Hospital discharge planning
- NHS procedures
- Cottage house plans
